# OneSimulation

> Physics simulation built API-first and AI-first: a full Python API, an MCP server for Codex and Claude Code, 16 physics modules and a wide choice of numerical methods.

Every part of OneSimulation is a Python API: geometry, mesh, physics, numerics and results. The included MCP server opens the same studies to Codex and Claude Code, so your assistant builds, runs and reads simulations on your machine. Nothing is fixed: 16 physics modules, finite elements, finite volumes, finite differences and discontinuous Galerkin, implicit and explicit time integrators, direct and Krylov solvers, multiphysics couplings and equations of your own.

Runtime Alpha 0.2.1a8 for CPython 3.13 on macOS (Apple Silicon), Ubuntu 22.04 (x86-64), Windows x64. OneSimulation is a closed binary package sold by subscription, with a seven-day trial and a free Education plan for students and teachers. Examples, tutorials and documentation are free to read.

## Start

- [Download, install and activate](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/tutorials/install/): from the download to the first run
- [Run a study from Codex or Claude Code](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/tutorials/#mcp): set up the included local MCP server
- [Documentation](https://johmey.github.io/OneSimulation-Showcase/): quickstart, guide and reference
- [API reference](https://johmey.github.io/OneSimulation-Showcase/reference/a-physics-api-reference/index.html): every class and function of the Python API
- [Getting started](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/tutorials/): first studies and how to check them

## Methods

- [Sod's shock tube through every method](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/tutorials/sod-shock-tube/): one Euler model through every discretization, limiter, Riemann solver, time integrator and linear solver
- [Numerical configuration and spatial operators](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/tutorials/discretization/): FEM, FVM, FDM and DG
- [Solvers, time integration and coupled fields](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/tutorials/solvers/): integrators, solvers, couplings
- [Define and solve your own equation](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/tutorials/custom-equation/): custom equations on the same stack
- [Comparison](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/compare/): against graphical multiphysics packages and open-source FEM libraries

## Who it is for

- [Students](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/for/students/): Lecture notes with the equations, exercises with worked solutions and examples whose exact answer is known. Change a mesh, a scheme or a time step and see what it does to the error.
- [Teaching](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/for/teaching/): A complete lab schedule, exercises with deliverables and examples graded against an exact solution. Students run the same library as research and industry users.
- [Research](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/for/research/): Physics, discretization, time integrator and solver are separate Python objects. Keep the model, swap the method, and grade every run against a reference.
- [Engineering offices](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/for/engineering/): Import the part, set loads and materials in Python, and deliver figures, fields and a comparison with a reference. Every study is a script you can rerun for the next variant.
- [Companies](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/for/companies/): Every part of OneSimulation is a Python API, so studies run from scripts, pipelines and your own applications. The included MCP server lets Codex and Claude Code build, run and read them on your machines.

## Plans

- [Plans and seven-day trial](https://johmey.gumroad.com/l/onesimulation-runtime-abo?section=subscribe): Personal & Research €19 per month, Focus €39 per month, Professional €79 per month

## Application Library: 377 worked examples

Each example has its governing model, setup, reference check, figures and a downloadable notebook.

### Acoustics

- [Acoustic cloak around a rigid cylinder](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/acoustic_cloak/): Pressure acoustics, metamaterials · 2D. A rigid cylinder five wavelengths around is wrapped in an anisotropic metamaterial shell that guides a sound wave around it.
- [Acoustic modes of a rigid box](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/rigid_box_acoustic_modes/): Pressure acoustics · 3D. The standing sound waves of a closed rectangular room: axial, tangential and oblique modes, including exactly degenerate pairs.
- [Baffled piston radiation](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/baffled_piston_radiation/): Pressure acoustics, frequency domain · 2D-axisymmetric. A loudspeaker-sized rigid piston in an infinite wall radiates sound into the half-space in front of it, up to ka = 5.
- [Double-slit diffraction of sound](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/double_slit_diffraction/): Pressure acoustics, frequency domain · 2D. Young's double-slit experiment with sound: a plane wave runs up two waveguides into a rigid screen and forms interference fringes behind it.
- [Ear canal acoustics](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/ear_canal_transfer/): Pressure acoustics, frequency domain · 3D. The human ear canal - a bent tube 25 mm long closed by the eardrum - and the pressure gain it gives around 3-4 kHz.
- [Eigenmodes in a muffler chamber](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/muffler_chamber_modes/): Pressure acoustics, duct modes · 2D. The propagating cross modes of an oval muffler chamber and the frequencies at which they cut on, the upper limit of plane-wave muffler design.
- [Eigenmodes of a room](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/room_eigenmodes/): Pressure acoustics, eigenmodes · 3D. The standing waves of a 5 m x 4 m living room whose ceiling slopes from 2.4 m to 3.4 m, up to 250 Hz.
- [Gaussian pulse absorbed by perfectly matched layers](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/gaussian_pulse_pml/): Pressure acoustics · 2D. A Gaussian pressure pulse spreading in 2D and leaving through perfectly matched layers: accuracy of the wave and how little comes back.
- [Helmholtz resonator in a wall](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/helmholtz_resonator_baffle/): Pressure acoustics, frequency domain · 2D-axisymmetric. A plane sound wave falls on a rigid wall with a Helmholtz resonator set into it; the cavity pressure rises sixty-fold at resonance.
- [Isospectral drums](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/isospectral_drums/): Membrane eigenmodes · 2D. The two eight-sided drumheads of Gordon, Webb and Wolpert: different shapes with exactly the same pitches.
- [Plane wave scattered by a rigid sphere](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/rigid_sphere_scattering/): Pressure acoustics, exterior scattering · 3D. The classical benchmark of exterior acoustics: a plane sound wave meets a sound-hard sphere at ka = 1 and ka = 3.
- [Radiation impedance of a flanged pipe](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/flanged_pipe_radiation_impedance/): Pressure acoustics, frequency domain · 2D-axisymmetric. A piston drives a pipe that opens through an infinite flange into free air; the open end is measured as an impedance and then replaces the outside air.
- [Remeshing per octave band](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/octave_band_remeshing/): Pressure acoustics, frequency domain · 3D. A frequency sweep over five octave bands in which every band gets its own mesh, sized to the wavelength at its upper edge.
- [Schroeder diffuser](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/schroeder_diffuser_scattering/): Pressure acoustics, scattering · 2D. A quadratic-residue diffuser set into a wall spreads a reflected sound wave over many directions; one period and four periods are compared.
- [Sound scattered by a rigid ellipsoid](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/ellipsoid_scattering/): Pressure acoustics, exterior scattering · 3D. An oblique plane wave meets a rigid ellipsoid with three different semi-axes; nothing in the problem is symmetric.
- [Transmission loss of an expansion-chamber muffler](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/expansion_chamber_muffler/): Pressure acoustics, frequency domain · 3D. A plane wave passes an oval-style expansion chamber with offset inlet and outlet pipes, as in a vehicle exhaust.

### Biophysics

- [Arterial pulse wave speed](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/arterial_pulse_wave_speed/): Circulation · 1D. A small pressure pulse travelling along an elastic artery, graded against the Moens-Korteweg wave speed.
- [Hodgkin-Huxley membrane action potential](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/hodgkin_huxley_propagation/): Bioelectrical · 0D. The space-clamped membrane of the squid giant axon fires an all-or-nothing action potential once a sudden depolarisation passes its threshold.
- [Inflation of an artery wall](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/arterial_wall_inflation/): Soft tissue mechanics · 3D. A segment of arterial media, reinforced by two helical families of collagen fibres, is stretched axially and inflated by the blood pressure.
- [Lumped model of a seated human body](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/human_body_lumped_vibration/): Biodynamics · 0D. Pelvis, abdomen, thorax, upper torso and head of a seated person form a five-degree-of-freedom chain of masses, springs and dampers on a vibrating seat.
- [Oscillations in a metabolic reaction network](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/glycolytic_oscillations_selkov/): Reaction kinetics · 0D. The Sel'kov model of glycolysis, a two-species network with an autocatalytic step that makes the metabolite concentrations oscillate.
- [Pacemaker electrodes: current distribution and pair resistance](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/pacing_electrode_pair_resistance/): Electric currents · 3D. Two hemispherical pacing electrodes on heart tissue drive an ionic current; the resistance between them and the crowding of the current on their facing sides.
- [Pennes bioheat: heating perfused tissue](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/pennes_bioheat_tissue_heating/): Bioheat transfer · 1D. A contact heater brings the skin to 45 °C over 30 mm of tissue, with and without blood perfusion, for one hour.
- [SEIR epidemic with Erlang stages](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/seir_epidemic_erlang_stages/): Epidemiology · 0D. An SEIR epidemic with R0 = 2.5 in a population of ten million, with exponential and with Erlang-distributed latent and infectious periods.
- [Simulation mesh from scanned data](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/mesh_from_scanned_data/): Image-based meshing · 3D. A segmented CT image of a bone with a cylindrical implant turned into one tetrahedral mesh of both materials without any CAD model.
- [Steady cable equation](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/cable_equation_steady/): Bioelectrical · 1D. Electrotonic voltage decay along a passive nerve cable, graded against cable theory.

### Chemistry

- [Acid-base equilibria and copper speciation in ammonia](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/copper_ammine_speciation/): Chemical equilibrium · 0D. Copper sulfate in ammonia solutions from 0.02 mmol/L to 2 mol/L: the four ammine complexes, the free ammonia and the pH of the solution.
- [Advection-diffusion-reaction transport](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/reactive_transport_1d/): Reactive transport · 1D. A reacting species carried by flow and diffusion; the steady profile is graded against the exact solution.
- [Arrhenius parameter estimation](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/arrhenius_parameter_estimation/): Reaction kinetics · 0D. Rate constant and activation energy of a first-order decomposition estimated from five isothermal batch experiments at once.
- [Arrhenius temperature dependence of a reaction rate](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/arrhenius_rate_temperature/): Reaction kinetics · 0D. A first-order decay run at several temperatures, graded against the Arrhenius law.
- [Capacity and power fade of a lumped battery](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/lumped_battery_capacity_fade/): Electrochemistry · 0D. A 5 Ah lithium-ion cell aged over ten years at 25, 35 and 45 °C by a diffusion-limited SEI film and daily cycling.
- [Charge stored by a blocking electrode](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/diffuse_double_layer_stern/): Electrochemistry · 1D. A charged metal surface attracts anions from a dilute electrolyte. Follow the nanometre-scale concentration profiles and the surface charge as the bias increases from 1 to 10 mV.
- [Consecutive reactions A to B to C](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/consecutive_reactions/): Reaction kinetics · 0D. A reaction chain A to B to C; the intermediate peak is graded against the series solution.
- [Constant-current discharge of a lumped battery](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/lumped_battery_constant_current/): Energy devices · 0D. A lumped battery discharged at constant current, graded against the linear state-of-charge law and the thermal balance.
- [Corrosion kinetics: Evans diagram](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/corrosion_mixed_potential_evans/): Electrochemistry · 0D. Iron in aerated water: anodic dissolution against oxygen reduction with a transport-limited current, the corrosion point and its dependence on the oxygen supply.
- [Cyclic voltammetry at a microdisk electrode](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/microdisk_electrode_voltammetry/): Electrochemistry · 2D-axisymmetric. A 10 um disk electrode in an insulating plane oxidises a redox species that reaches it by hemispherical diffusion; slow sweeps give a steady sigmoidal wave, fast sweeps a peaked one.
- [Cyclic voltammetry at a planar macroelectrode](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/cyclic_voltammetry_macroelectrode/): Electrochemistry · 1D. The potential of a large planar electrode is swept up and back while a one-electron redox couple diffuses to and from its surface, for kinetics from reversible to irreversible.
- [Danckwerts benchmark: tubular reactor with axial dispersion](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/danckwerts_tubular_reactor/): Reactive transport · 1D. A first-order reaction in a back-mixed tube, from almost stirred tank to almost plug flow, with the concentration jump at the inlet.
- [Degradation of plasmid DNA in blood plasma](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/plasmid_dna_degradation_kinetics/): Reaction kinetics · 0D. Nucleases in plasma convert supercoiled plasmid DNA into the open-circular and linear forms and digest it into fragments.
- [Diffusion through a porous strip](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/porous_effective_diffusivity/): Mass transport · 2D. How much does an array of solid grains slow diffusion? Four strips with different solid fractions give the effective diffusivity from the solute flux.
- [Diffusion-reaction in a catalyst slab](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/catalyst_slab_thiele/): Reaction-diffusion · 1D. Diffusion with a first-order reaction in a catalyst slab, graded against the Thiele solution.
- [Discharge, rest and recharge of a lithium-ion cell](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/lithium_ion_discharge_rest_charge/): Electrochemistry · 1D. A 5 Ah graphite-SiOx | NMC811 cell with published parameters, discharged at 1C, left at rest and recharged, resolved through its thickness and into its particles.
- [Electrode balancing and state of charge of a lithium-ion cell](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/lithium_ion_electrode_balancing/): Electrochemistry · 1D. Four lithiation limits and the cell state of charge set up a 5 Ah graphite-SiOx | NMC811 cell model and decide which electrode limits its capacity.
- [Equivalent-circuit battery identification](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/battery_equivalent_circuit_estimation/): Batteries · 0D. Series resistance and RC branch of a lithium-ion equivalent-circuit model identified from the terminal voltage of a pulse test.
- [Equivalent-circuit model of a nickel-metal hydride cell](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/nimh_equivalent_circuit/): Electrochemistry · 0D. A 2.5 Ah NiMH cell as voltage source, series resistance, one RC branch and an Arrhenius self-discharge, in a pulse test, an impedance sweep and on the shelf.
- [Fermentation in beer brewing](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/beer_fermentation_kinetics/): Bioprocess kinetics · 0D. Wort fermented by yeast at lager and ale temperatures: yeast growth, sugar consumption, alcohol and carbon dioxide.
- [First-order reaction decay](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/first_order_reaction_decay/): Reaction kinetics · 0D. A first-order reaction A to B; the concentrations are graded against the exact exponential.
- [Gas-phase equilibrium of ethylene hydration to ethanol](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/ethylene_hydration_equilibrium/): Chemical equilibrium · 0D. How much ethylene can turn into ethanol over steam at 175 to 425 C and 5 to 150 bar, the trade-off behind the industrial hydration process.
- [Hydrogen iodide batch reactor, isothermal and adiabatic](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/hydrogen_iodide_batch_reactor/): Reaction kinetics · 0D. The reversible gas reaction 2 HI = H2 + I2 in a rigid vessel, held at 700 to 800 K or left to cool by its own reaction heat.
- [Ibuprofen synthesis: carbonylation kinetics with gas absorption](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/ibuprofen_carbonylation_kinetics/): Reaction kinetics · 0D. The palladium-catalysed carbonylation of 1-(4-isobutylphenyl)ethanol to ibuprofen in a stirred autoclave fed with carbon monoxide through the gas-liquid interface.
- [Internal resistance of a lithium-ion cell from current pulses](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/lithium_ion_internal_resistance_pulse/): Electrochemistry · 1D. Current pulses on a 5 Ah graphite-SiOx | NMC811 cell at rest reveal its instantaneous and growing internal resistance.
- [Isothermal sodium-ion cell in 1D](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/sodium_ion_cell_discharge_1d/): Electrochemistry · 1D. A hard carbon | Na3V2(PO4)2F3 sodium-ion cell with its sloping anode and two-plateau cathode, discharged at C/10, C/2 and 1C.
- [Lithium-ion cell with a single-ion conducting electrolyte](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/single_ion_conductor_battery_discharge/): Batteries · 1D. An LG M50 cell whose liquid electrolyte is replaced by a single-ion conductor (transference number one) is discharged at two rates and three ionic conductivities.
- [Lumped battery parameter estimation](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/lumped_battery_parameter_estimation/): Batteries · 0D. Capacity, internal resistance, heat capacity and cooling of a lumped battery model estimated from voltage and temperature over a one-hour load cycle.
- [Mass transfer out of a thin flow channel](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/thin_channel_wall_mass_transfer/): Mass transport · 2D. A gas flows through a thin channel with two permeable walls; the channel is computed in its mid-plane with the wall transfer as an out-of-plane sink.
- [Mixing two feeds in a porous catalytic reactor](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/porous_catalytic_reactor_injection_needle/): Reacting flow in porous media · 3D. A side needle injects the second reactant into a packed bed. Follow the plume downstream and measure how much reacts before leaving the bed.
- [Monitoring a lithium-ion cell over a hybrid-vehicle drive cycle](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/lithium_ion_drive_cycle/): Electrochemistry · 1D. A 5 Ah graphite-SiOx | NMC811 cell driven through three charge-sustaining hybrid-vehicle microcycles with pulses of up to 2.6C, then left at rest.
- [Neutralisation of chlorine in a scrubber](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/chlorine_scrubber_neutralization/): Reaction kinetics · 0D. Dissolved chlorine destroyed by the hydroxide of an alkaline scrubber liquid within microseconds.
- [Parameter estimation for a non-ideal stirred reactor](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/dead_zone_reactor_parameter_estimation/): Reaction engineering · 0D. A poorly mixed stirred tank modelled as a well-mixed zone and a dead zone that exchange liquid, identified from a tracer step experiment.
- [Phase separation of a quenched binary mixture](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/binary_alloy_phase_separation/): Phase field, Cahn-Hilliard · 2D. A binary mixture quenched into its unstable range separates into two phases by spinodal decomposition and starts to coarsen.
- [Potential profile in an electrochemical cell](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/electrochemical_cell_potential_profile/): Electrochemistry · 1D. The potential across a zinc-copper cell at open circuit, during discharge and during charge, with the steps at the electrodes and the ohmic drop in between.
- [Power losses of a lithium-ion cell in a hybrid pulse power test](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/lithium_ion_hppc_power_losses/): Electrochemistry · 1D. A 5 Ah graphite-SiOx | NMC811 cell runs through a hybrid pulse power test at 80, 50 and 20 % state of charge, and every watt it loses is traced to its origin.
- [Rate capability of a lithium-ion cell](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/lithium_ion_rate_capability/): Electrochemistry · 1D. A 5 Ah graphite-SiOx | NMC811 cell discharged at six rates from C/10 to 1.5C, and why its electrolyte sets the limit.
- [Reversible reaction equilibrium](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/reversible_reaction_equilibrium/): Reaction kinetics · 0D. A reversible reaction A to/from B relaxing to equilibrium; transient and equilibrium are graded against theory.
- [Second-order batch reactor](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/batch_reactor_second_order/): Reaction kinetics · 0D. A second-order reaction in a batch reactor, graded against the hyperbolic decay.
- [Semibatch polymerisation with volume shrinkage](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/semibatch_polymerization_volume_shrinkage/): Reaction engineering · 0D. Styrene polymerises in a stirred tank fed with monomer for two hours; the denser polymer makes the liquid shrink and every concentration rise.
- [Separation in a liquid chromatography column](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/liquid_chromatography_langmuir_column/): Reactive transport · 1D. Two solutes injected into a packed column adsorb on a shared stationary phase with competitive Langmuir kinetics and leave the column as separated peaks.
- [Single-particle model against the full porous-electrode model](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/single_particle_model_vs_dfn/): Electrochemistry · 1D. The single-particle model of a 5 Ah graphite-SiOx | NMC811 cell, checked against the exact diffusion series and compared with the SPMe and the full Doyle-Fuller-Newman model from C/10 to 1C.
- [Spinodal decomposition benchmark](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/spinodal_decomposition_benchmark/): Phase field, Cahn-Hilliard · 2D. The first benchmark of the phase-field community: a concentration close to 0.5 decomposes into the phases 0.3 and 0.7 on a 200 x 200 square with no-flux walls and coarsens.
- [Startup of a continuous stirred-tank reactor](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/cstr_startup_dynamics/): Reaction engineering · 0D. Starting up an exothermic propylene-glycol reactor: the temperature spike during startup, whether it crosses the safety limit, and the stable operating point.
- [Stefan tube: multicomponent evaporation](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/stefan_tube_multicomponent_evaporation/): Mass transport · 1D. Acetone and methanol evaporate from a liquid mixture through stagnant air in a vertical tube; the ternary Maxwell-Stefan fluxes couple the two vapours.
- [Stirred tank reactors in series with level control](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/stirred_tanks_variable_volume_level_control/): Process systems · 0D. Two ideally mixed tank reactors in series fill up under fixed flows, then proportional level controllers on the outlet valves draw them down to a steady state.
- [Thin-layer chronoamperometry](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/thin_layer_chronoamperometry/): Electrochemistry · 1D. A potential step reduces all electroactive species in a 50 um solution layer; current and charge are followed until the layer is exhausted.
- [Transient diffusion into a slab](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/transient_diffusion_slab/): Mass transport · 1D. A species diffuses into a slab from one face; the uptake profile is graded against the series solution.
- [Tubular steam reformer geometry](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/steam_reformer_geometry/): CAD geometry · 3D. Nineteen catalyst tubes on two rings in a cylindrical shell with inlet and outlet plenums, built as catalyst beds and shell space.

### Electromagnetics

- [A user-defined nonlinear B-H law: saturation of a ring core](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/nonlinear_bh_ferrite_ring/): Magnetostatics · 3D. A finite magnetic ring core on a straight conductor saturates as the current grows, like a ferrite bead or the core of a current transformer.
- [A waveguide built into a circuit board](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/substrate_integrated_waveguide/): Microwave engineering · 3D. Two rows of plated vias guide a microwave signal through the board. Measure the signal on either side of cutoff and inspect its phase inside the guide.
- [AC resistance and sheath losses of a three-core power cable](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/three_core_cable_ac_losses/): Low-frequency electromagnetics, cables · 2D. The cross-section of a three-core 220 kV submarine cable with 500 mm2 copper conductors and lead sheaths bonded at both ends, carrying balanced 50 Hz currents.
- [Axial magnetic bearing with permanent magnets](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/axial_magnetic_bearing_force/): Magnetostatics · 3D. Two axially magnetised NdFeB ring magnets that repel each other across an air gap and form a passive, contactless axial bearing.
- [Axisymmetric cavity resonator](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/axisymmetric_cavity_resonator/): Microwaves, cavity resonators · 2D-axisymmetric. The resonant modes and fields of a closed cylindrical (pillbox) cavity, computed on its meridian plane for the TE0, TM0 and vector families of azimuthal order 0, 1 and 2.
- [Band gaps of a one-dimensional photonic crystal](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/one_dimensional_photonic_crystal_bands/): Wave optics, photonic crystals · 2D. The photonic bands of a multilayer stack for a uniform medium, a weak and a strong index contrast, with the band gaps that open at the edge of the Brillouin zone.
- [Bolted busbar assembly geometry](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/busbar_assembly_geometry/): CAD geometry · 3D. A copper busbar with two bends, two bolt holes, two washers and two bolts, built as an assembly with named parts and contact faces.
- [Capacitance matrix of a touchscreen with and without a finger](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/touchscreen_capacitance_matrix/): Electrostatics · 3D. A projected-capacitive touchscreen with three rows and three columns, with and without a finger on the glass.
- [Capacitance matrix of two spheres](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/two_spheres_capacitance_matrix/): Electrostatics · 3D. Two conducting spheres of different size near each other: the full 2x2 capacitance matrix, graded against the exact bispherical series.
- [Capacitance of a disc capacitor with fringing fields](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/disc_capacitor_fringing/): Electrostatics · 3D. Two metal discs with a glass dielectric and leads in an air domain: the capacitance including the fringing field at the rim.
- [Capacitive position sensor: capacitance matrix of a five-terminal system](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/capacitive_position_sensor/): Electrostatics · 3D. Four copper pads on a circuit board sense a metal target above them; the capacitances between target and pads tell where the target is.
- [Cascaded rectangular cavity filter](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/cascaded_cavity_filter/): Microwaves, waveguide filters · 3D. Three rectangular cavities in a WR-90 waveguide, coupled through rounded slots in 2 mm walls, form a three-pole Chebyshev bandpass filter for 9.8 to 10.2 GHz.
- [Characteristic impedance of a coaxial cable](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/coaxial_cable_impedance/): Transmission lines · 2D. The capacitance, inductance and characteristic impedance of a 50-ohm-class polyethylene coaxial cable, concentric and with a displaced inner conductor.
- [Characteristic impedance of a parallel-wire line](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/parallel_wire_line_impedance/): Transmission lines · 2D. The capacitance, inductance and characteristic impedance of two 0.5 mm wires 5 mm apart in air, a balanced transmission line whose field reaches into the open surroundings.
- [Circular waveguide iris filter](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/circular_waveguide_iris_filter/): Microwaves, waveguide filters · 2D-axisymmetric. Two annular irises in a circular waveguide form a narrow-band cavity filter for the low-loss TE01 mode.
- [Coaxial probe to waveguide transition](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/coaxial_probe_waveguide_transition/): Microwaves, waveguides · 3D. The inner conductor of a 50-ohm coaxial line reaches into a shorted WR-90 waveguide and launches its TE10 wave, matched at 10 GHz by probe length and short.
- [Conical dielectric probe on skin at 35 GHz](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/conical_dielectric_probe/): Electromagnetic waves · 2D-axisymmetric. A PTFE cone fed by a circular waveguide touches the skin; its reflection at 30 to 40 GHz is compared for healthy skin and for a tumour lesion of higher water content under the tip.
- [Contact impedance of a thin resistive shell](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/contact_impedance_resistive_shell/): Electric currents · 2D. A steady current flows through a conducting plate around a tube whose 1 cm wall conducts poorly; the wall is resolved once and replaced by a contact impedance once.
- [Current through a thin resistive film in a layered device](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/thin_resistive_film_stack/): Electric currents · 3D. A current of 0.3 A crosses a layered device through a 20 mm resistive film between a base plate and a cover with a round contact pad; the film is resolved by the mesh once and replaced by a contact impedance once.
- [Dielectric shielding by a thin high-permittivity shell](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/dielectric_shell_field_shielding/): Electrostatics · 2D. A tube with a thin wall of relative permittivity 20 sits between two capacitor plates and screens its inside; the wall is resolved once and replaced by a thin dielectric layer once, for four wall thicknesses.
- [Dielectric slab waveguide](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/dielectric_slab_waveguide_modes/): Wave optics, guided waves · 2D. A polyethylene slab in air guides millimetre waves; its TE and TM modes are computed and one of them is launched along the guide.
- [Eddy currents in a cylinder inside a long coil](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/eddy_currents_cylinder_in_coil/): Eddy currents · 2D-axisymmetric. An aluminium cylinder in a long coil at 50 Hz, 500 Hz and 5 kHz: the field is pushed out of the core and the eddy currents heat it.
- [Effective B-H curve in a harmonic model against transient saturation](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/effective_bh_curve_frequency_domain/): Eddy currents, nonlinear magnetics · 2D. A 100-turn winding on one leg of a laminated steel frame core is driven at 50 Hz into saturation; a harmonic model with the energy-equivalent effective B-H curve is compared with the transient solution and with the initial permeability.
- [Eigenmodes of a rectangular metallic cavity](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/rectangular_cavity_eigenmodes/): Microwaves, resonators · 2D. The lowest TM and TE resonances of the cross-section of a 200 mm x 100 mm metallic cavity, computed in three formulations.
- [Electric field between coaxial cylinders](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/electric_field_coaxial_cylinders/): Electrostatics · 1D. A coaxial capacitor computed on a radial line between the inner and the outer conductor.
- [Electric sensor: dielectric objects in a box](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/dielectric_inclusion_sensor/): Electrostatics · 3D. A capacitive sensor box with a driven top and a grounded bottom electrode: two dielectric objects standing on the bottom electrode leave their imprint in the surface charge on the top electrode.
- [Electric sensor: permittivity sweep over two objects in a box](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/electric_sensor_permittivity_imaging/): Electrostatics · 3D. Two charge probes on the top electrode of a capacitive sensor box image two dielectric objects below them; a batch of 3D solutions sweeps the permittivities of both and reads an unknown one back.
- [Electric shielding by a thin conductive shell](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/conductive_shell_current_shielding/): Electric currents · 2D. A steady current flows through a conducting plate around a tube whose 1 cm wall conducts up to a thousand times better than the plate; the wall is resolved once and replaced by a thin conductive layer once.
- [Fabry-Perot etalon](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/fabry_perot_etalon_transmission/): Wave optics, interference · 2D. A 2 mm silicon plate in air is swept from 60 to 160 GHz at normal and oblique incidence and transmits fully at its Fabry-Perot resonances.
- [Force between two coaxial coils: a verification series](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/coil_force_verification/): Magnetostatics · 3D. Two coaxial coils of 100 turns each attract each other; the force is computed for three distances and compared with Maxwell's mutual inductance.
- [Force between two parallel current-carrying wires](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/parallel_wires_ampere_force_2d/): Magnetostatics · 2D. Two long wires 1 m apart carrying 1 A each attract with the force that once defined the ampere.
- [Fresnel equations at oblique incidence](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/fresnel_oblique_incidence/): Wave optics, plane waves · 2D. A plane wave meets a glass surface at every angle of incidence, in both polarizations and from both sides.
- [Fringing fields of a thick-plate capacitor](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/fringing_field_capacitor/): Electrostatics · 3D. Two thick metal discs in a spherical air domain: how the fringing field raises the capacitance and how the size of the air domain biases the result.
- [Gold nanoparticle on a glass substrate](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/gold_nanoparticle_on_substrate/): Wave optics · 3D. A gold sphere of 100 nm diameter 5 nm above glass is lit by a TE plane wave at 45 degrees from two azimuthal directions; absorption and scattering cross-sections at 550 nm.
- [H-plane bend of a rectangular waveguide](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/waveguide_h_bend/): Microwaves, waveguides · 3D. A WR-90 rectangular waveguide turns by 90 degrees in the plane of its broad walls; the TE10 wave is followed through the bend over the X band.
- [Half-wave dipole antenna](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/half_wave_dipole_antenna/): Antennas · 2D-axisymmetric. A centre-fed wire dipole of 0.48 wavelengths, fed by a lumped port across a 2 mm gap, radiates into free space around 1 GHz.
- [Horseshoe permanent magnet](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/horseshoe_permanent_magnet/): Magnetostatics · 3D. A soft-iron horseshoe whose two pole pieces are magnetized in opposite directions, solved for its 3D field.
- [Hyperbolic waves in a metal-dielectric layered metamaterial](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/hyperbolic_metamaterial_layers/): Wave optics · 2D. Eight bilayers of 20 nm silver and 20 nm dielectric act as a hyperbolic medium at 800 nm: reflection and transmission of TM light, and the resonance cones of a line source.
- [Inductance from the magnetic field energy](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/solenoid_inductance_from_energy/): Magnetostatics · 3D. The inductance of a finite thick-winding solenoid extracted from the magnetic energy, graded against the Nagaoka-corrected closed form.
- [Inductance of a gapped power inductor with a saturating core](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/power_inductor_inductance/): Magnetostatics · 3D. A 20-turn winding in a ferrite pot core with an air gap in its centre post: the inductance stays nearly constant at small currents and drops when the ferrite saturates.
- [Induction currents from a circular coil in a copper ring](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/induction_currents_coil_and_ring/): Eddy currents · 2D-axisymmetric. A circular coil induces currents in a coaxial short-circuited copper ring, alternating from 10 Hz to 10 kHz and after switching on.
- [Interior field of a long solenoid](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/long_solenoid_interior_field/): Magnetostatics · 3D. The uniform interior field of a long solenoid, graded against mu0 n I.
- [Iron sphere in a uniform magnetic field](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/iron_sphere_in_uniform_field/): Magnetostatics · 3D. A highly permeable sphere placed in a uniform field: field concentration inside, dipole distortion outside, and the bias of a too-small air domain.
- [Light scattered by a rough metal coating](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/rough_surface_scattering_floquet/): Wave optics, diffraction · 2D. Red light falls on glass with a 50 nm gold coating, once optically flat and once with a rough top surface; reflectance, transmittance, absorptance and diffuse scattering for both polarizations.
- [Magnetic field of a Helmholtz coil](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/helmholtz_coil_field/): Magnetostatics · 3D. Two coaxial coils one radius apart: the famously uniform field at the centre, and how mesh, coil faceting and the air domain each limit the accuracy.
- [Magnetic field of a three-phase power line over three spans](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/power_line_magnetic_field_3d/): Magnetostatics · 3D. The 50 Hz magnetic field under a 400 kV line whose conductors sag between towers 300 m apart.
- [Magnetic force by virtual work and by the Maxwell stress tensor](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/magnet_force_virtual_work_maxwell/): Magnetostatics · 3D. The repulsive force between the two ring magnets of a passive axial bearing, computed from the change of the field energy and from the Maxwell stress in the air gap.
- [Magnetic prospecting of a buried iron ore body](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/magnetic_prospecting_ore_body/): Magnetostatics · 3D. A magnetite body 100 m below the surface disturbs the inclined Earth field; the magnetometer anomaly is mapped on the surface.
- [Magnetic stiffness of an axial permanent-magnet bearing](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/axial_bearing_magnetic_stiffness/): Magnetostatics · 3D. Two repelling ring magnets form a passive axial bearing; its axial and radial stiffness follow from the forces when the upper magnet is moved.
- [Metal scatterer near an optical waveguide](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/waveguide_metal_scatterer/): Wave optics · 2D. A gold rod of 0.2 um diameter next to a silicon nitride slab waveguide reflects, absorbs and scatters part of the guided light from 1.3 to 1.8 um, for TE and TM.
- [Microstrip branch-line coupler](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/microstrip_branch_line_coupler/): Microwave circuits · 3D. A 3 dB quadrature hybrid of four quarter-wave microstrip lines on a 0.813 mm substrate splits a 3 GHz signal into two equal halves 90 degrees apart.
- [Microstrip coupled-line bandpass filter](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/coupled_line_bandpass_filter/): Microwave circuits · 3D. A third-order, 0.5 dB equal-ripple bandpass filter of four edge-coupled microstrip sections, designed for 5 GHz with 10 % bandwidth.
- [Microstrip rat-race coupler](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/microstrip_rat_race_coupler/): Microwave circuits · 3D. A microstrip ring one and a half wavelengths around with four ports forms the 180-degree hybrid at 3 GHz: fed at the sum port it splits in phase, fed at the difference port in antiphase.
- [Microstrip Wilkinson power divider](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/microstrip_wilkinson_power_divider/): Microwave circuits · 3D. Two quarter-wave microstrip arms split a 3 GHz signal equally while a 100-ohm resistor between their ends isolates the two outputs.
- [Mode analysis of a rectangular waveguide cross-section](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/waveguide_mode_analysis/): Electromagnetic waves · 2D. The first eight TE and TM modes of a WR-90 waveguide cross-section with their cutoff frequencies and field patterns.
- [Monoconical antenna on a finite ground plane](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/conical_monopole_antenna/): Antennas · 2D-axisymmetric. A metal cone of 47 degrees half angle on a ground disc, fed by a 50 ohm generator at its tip, swept from 1 to 5 GHz.
- [Monopole antenna fed by a magnetic frill](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/monopole_magnetic_frill_feed/): Antennas · 2D-axisymmetric. A 70 mm monopole on an infinite ground plane is fed through the plane by a 50 ohm coaxial line; impedance, reflection, radiated power and pattern are computed from 0.8 to 1.3 GHz.
- [Mutual inductance of a ring and a coil of 20 resolved turns](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/explicit_turns_coil_mutual_inductance/): Eddy currents · 2D-axisymmetric. A coil of 20 copper turns sits at the centre of a single-turn copper ring of 100 mm radius; mutual inductance, coil impedance and the current induced in the short-circuited coil at 1 kHz.
- [Mutual inductance of a ring and a homogenized 20-turn coil](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/homogenized_coil_mutual_inductance/): Eddy currents · 2D-axisymmetric. A coil of 20 turns sits at the centre of a single-turn copper ring of 100 mm radius; the coil is a homogenized winding. Mutual inductance, coil impedance and the current induced in the short-circuited coil at 1 kHz.
- [On-axis field of a solenoid](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/solenoid_on_axis_field/): Magnetostatics · 3D. The on-axis field profile of a finite solenoid, graded against the finite-solenoid formula.
- [One-sided Halbach magnet attracting a steel plate](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/halbach_magnet_steel_plate_force/): Magnetostatics · 3D. Five NdFeB blocks with turning magnetization concentrate their flux on one side and pull on a steel plate.
- [Optical ring resonator notch filter](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/ring_resonator_notch_filter/): Wave optics · 2D. A weakly absorbing silicon ring of 2 um radius next to a straight silicon waveguide removes narrow bands from the transmitted light between 1.50 and 1.60 um.
- [Optimizing the currents of a coil system for a uniform field](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/coil_current_optimization_axisymmetric/): Magnetostatics · 2D-axisymmetric. The currents of six coaxial coils are tuned with real simulations so that the axial field stays at 1 mT over 40 cm.
- [Photonic crystal: band gap and bent waveguide](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/photonic_crystal_band_gap/): Wave optics, photonic crystals · 2D. A square lattice of alumina rods forbids TM waves in a band of frequencies, and a bent row of missing rods guides the wave around a sharp corner.
- [Plane-wave scattering at any angle on a 2D-axisymmetric model](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/sphere_scattering_azimuthal_modes/): Wave scattering · 2D-axisymmetric. A dielectric sphere hit by plane waves along its axis, at 45 degrees and across it, solved on its meridian plane one azimuthal mode at a time.
- [Plasmonic waveguide filter](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/plasmonic_waveguide_stub_filter/): Plasmonics, waveguides · 2D. A 50 nm air channel between silver blocks guides a gap plasmon; a 250 nm side stub stops the band around 1.5 um.
- [Plasmonic wire grating](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/plasmonic_wire_grating/): Plasmonics, diffraction gratings · 2D. A grating of 40 nm silver wires, 400 nm apart above glass, is lit by 550 nm light at all angles; specular and first-order reflection and transmission and the absorption are computed for both polarizations.
- [Polarized ports of a circular waveguide](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/polarized_circular_waveguide_port/): Electromagnetic waves · 3D. A circular waveguide whose degenerate TE11 port modes are aligned and combined into a linearly and a circularly polarized wave.
- [Position optimisation of grading rings on an insulator](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/grading_ring_position_optimisation/): Electrostatics · 2D-axi. A 1 m rod insulator at 100 kV with grading rings at both ends, whose distance from the rod ends is chosen to minimise the field on the insulator surface.
- [Q factors and resonant frequencies of cavity resonators](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/cavity_resonator_q_factors/): Microwaves, cavity resonators · 3D. Rectangular, cylindrical and spherical cavities with copper walls: their lowest resonances and the conductor quality factors.
- [Q factors of axisymmetric cavity resonators](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/axisymmetric_cavity_q_factors/): Microwaves, cavity resonators · 2D-axisymmetric. A cylindrical and a spherical copper cavity solved on their meridian planes, azimuthal order by azimuthal order, with resonance frequencies and conductor Q.
- [Radar cross section of a ship](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/radar_cross_section_ship/): Wave scattering, radar · 2D. A 150 MHz radar wave meets the side silhouette of a 12 m boat; the bistatic and monostatic radar cross sections are computed for both polarizations.
- [Reflection of a circularly polarized wave at glass](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/circular_wave_glass_reflection/): Electromagnetic waves · 3D. A circularly polarized 3 GHz plane wave in air hitting glass of index 1.5 at normal incidence.
- [Resistance of a straight and a bent copper wire](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/wire_resistance_straight_and_bent/): Electric currents · 3D. A short copper wire, straight and as a tight quarter bend, whose resistance follows from a 1 mV voltage and the current it drives.
- [Resolving a resonance between Bragg mirrors](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/fabry_perot_bragg_mirror_resonator/): Wave optics · 2D. Two dielectric mirrors enclose an air gap. A two-dimensional Maxwell frequency sweep resolves the narrow transmission line inside their stop band.
- [Resonances of a rectangular cavity](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/rectangular_cavity_resonance/): Electromagnetic waves · 3D. A pulse ringing in a closed metal box, graded against the analytic cavity resonances.
- [RLGC parameters, characteristic impedance and attenuation of a coaxial cable](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/coax_rlgc_frequency_sweep/): Electrostatics, eddy currents · 2D. A copper coaxial cable with a slightly lossy polyethylene dielectric: its four line parameters per metre, the characteristic impedance and the attenuation from 10 kHz to 100 MHz.
- [Self and mutual inductance of two coplanar loops](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/coplanar_loops_mutual_inductance/): Magnetostatics · 3D. Two concentric single-turn copper loops of 50 mm and 100 mm radius lie in one plane; their self-inductances, their mutual inductance and the current induced in the short-circuited secondary are computed.
- [Self and mutual inductance of two coplanar rings and the induced current](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/coplanar_rings_inductance_axisymmetric/): Eddy currents · 2D-axisymmetric. Two concentric copper rings of 100 mm and 10 mm radius lie in one plane; their self-inductances, their mutual inductance and the current induced in the short-circuited inner ring at 1 kHz.
- [Small-signal inductance of an inductor with a nonlinear core](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/inductor_small_signal_axisymmetric/): Low-frequency electromagnetics, inductors · 2D-axisymmetric. A pot-core inductor with a gapped steel core and 200 turns carries a direct bias current from 0.25 to 8 A plus a small alternating current.
- [Static field of a Halbach rotor](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/halbach_rotor_field/): Magnetostatics · 3D. A finite four-pole Halbach rotor ring whose rotating magnetisation concentrates the field outside the rotor and nearly cancels it in the bore.
- [Surface field of a high-voltage insulator with a grading ring](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/high_voltage_insulator_grading_ring/): Electrostatics · 3D. A 110 kV composite long-rod insulator with and without a grading ring at its live end.
- [Surface plasmon excitation in the Otto and Kretschmann configurations](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/surface_plasmon_prism_coupling/): Plasmonics, wave optics · 2D. Light of 633 nm totally reflected in a glass prism excites a surface plasmon on gold through a 50 nm film (Kretschmann) or across a 450 nm air gap (Otto).
- [Surface plasmon polariton on a silver-air interface](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/metal_air_surface_plasmon_propagation/): Plasmonics, waveguide modes · 2D. A surface plasmon polariton travels along a silver-air interface; its dispersion up to the surface plasmon frequency and its propagation length are computed.
- [Surface plasmons of a thin silver film in glass](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/thin_film_surface_plasmon_dispersion/): Plasmonics, waveguide modes · 2D. A 40 nm silver film in glass carries a long-range and a short-range surface plasmon; their dispersion and propagation length are computed from 1.2 to 3.2 eV.
- [TE10 mode of a rectangular waveguide](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/rectangular_waveguide_te10/): Electromagnetic waves · 3D. The fundamental TE10 mode of a shorted rectangular waveguide, graded against the analytic cutoff and standing wave.
- [TE11 and TM01 modes of a circular waveguide](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/circular_waveguide_te11_cutoff/): Electromagnetic waves · 3D. The lowest modes of a circular waveguide, graded against the Bessel-root cutoff frequencies.
- [Thin low-permittivity gap in a dielectric capacitor](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/thin_low_permittivity_gap_capacitor/): Electrostatics · 2D. A capacitor filled with a dielectric of relative permittivity 20 contains a thin circular air gap; the gap is resolved once and replaced by a thin dielectric layer once, for four gap widths.
- [Transmission line parameters: coaxial cable and twin lead](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/transmission_line_parameters/): Electrostatics, magnetostatics, eddy currents · 2D. Capacitance, inductance and frequency-dependent resistance per metre of an RG-58 class coaxial cable and a 300-ohm twin lead.
- [Trimmer capacitor with a rotating electrode](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/trimmer_capacitor_rotation/): Electrostatics · 3D. An air-gap trimmer whose half-disc rotor turns over a half-disc stator, with its capacitance against the rotor angle.
- [Waveguide iris bandpass filter](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/waveguide_iris_bandpass_filter/): Microwaves, waveguide filters · 3D. Four symmetric inductive irises in a WR-90 waveguide form a three-pole Chebyshev bandpass filter for 9.7 to 10.3 GHz.
- [Waveguide with several propagating modes](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/multimode_waveguide_scattering/): Microwaves, waveguide ports · 2D. A metal waveguide wide enough for three modes holds a dielectric insert; every mode is fed in turn and its S-parameters are computed.
- [Whispering-gallery modes of a dielectric microsphere](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/whispering_gallery_microsphere/): Optics, microresonators · 2D-axisymmetric. A 4 um silica microsphere guides light around its rim: the whispering-gallery modes of azimuthal order 18 with their wavelengths and radiation quality factors.

### Flow & Heat

- [3D thermal bridge (ISO 10211 case 4)](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/thermal_bridge_3d_iso10211/): Heat transfer · 3D. An iron bar crossing an insulation layer: the 3D validation case of the building standard for thermal bridges.
- [A point source in a disk](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/point_source_unit_disk/): Poisson equation · 2D. A unit source at the center of a disk produces a logarithmic potential. Follow it along a radius and see how refining the mesh improves the profile.
- [Advection-diffusion in a channel](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/advection_diffusion_1d/): Heat transfer · 3D. Steady transport of heat by a flow plus conduction; the Peclet profile is graded against theory.
- [Axisymmetric ring heated in its bore](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/axisymmetric_ring_steady_conduction/): Heat conduction · 2D-axisymmetric. A NAFEMS benchmark for axisymmetric conduction: a thick steel ring heated over a band of its bore and held at 0 °C outside.
- [Axisymmetric transient heating of a cylinder](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/axisymmetric_cylinder_transient_heating/): Heat transfer · 2D-axisymmetric. The NAFEMS axisymmetric transient benchmark: a cold steel cylinder whose whole surface is suddenly held at 1000 °C.
- [Bulk temperature in a heated square duct](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/bulk_temperature_square_duct/): Forced convection · 3D. Water in a square duct with uniformly heated walls, and the bulk (mixing-cup) temperature that every heat transfer coefficient refers to.
- [Buoyancy-driven flow in a differentially heated square cavity](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/differentially_heated_square_cavity/): Free convection · 2D. A square cavity heated on one side and cooled on the other: buoyancy sets up a circulation that carries the heat across, the classic test of every free-convection solver.
- [Buoyancy-driven PCR in a triangular loop](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/buoyancy_driven_pcr_loop/): Free convection · 3D. A pump-free PCR chip: buoyancy drives the sample around an upright triangular loop whose legs are held at the denaturation, annealing and extension temperatures, one lap per thermal cycle.
- [Circuit board with a disk-stack heat sink](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/disk_stack_heat_sink_board/): Heat transfer · 3D. A circuit board with three chip packages, cooled by natural convection, first bare and then with a disk-stack heat sink on its main chip.
- [Composite thermal barrier: resolved layers and a lumped resistance](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/composite_thermal_barrier_lumped/): Heat transfer · 3D. A copper heater on a barrier of four thin insulating layers over a cooled aluminium plate, modelled once with the layers meshed and once with the layers replaced by a lumped thermal resistance.
- [Composite thermal barrier: resolved layers and a thin-layer condition](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/composite_thermal_barrier_thin_layer/): Heat transfer · 3D. A steel cylinder half heated to 1220 °C on top carries a barrier of two ceramic layers, 50 µm and 75 µm, at mid-height; the barrier is resolved by swept hexahedra once and replaced by a thermal contact once.
- [Cooling a finite slab from both faces](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/heat_conduction_finite_slab/): Heat transfer · 1D. Cooling both faces of a slab leaves its core warm. Follow six temperature profiles as the two cooling fronts meet.
- [Cooling a nickel rod in boiling water](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/nickel_rod_boiling_quench/): Heat transfer · 3D. A hot nickel rod cools in saturated water. See the surface cool first and compare three minutes of the transient with a lumped heat balance.
- [Counterflow heat exchanger (effectiveness-NTU)](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/counterflow_heat_exchanger_ntu/): Heat transfer · 3D. Hot and cold streams exchanging heat through a wall, graded against the effectiveness-NTU relations.
- [Counterflow MEMS heat exchanger](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/mems_counterflow_heat_exchanger/): Conjugate heat transfer · 3D. Hot and cold water in two parallel microchannels of a stainless-steel chip, flowing in opposite directions and exchanging heat through the steel.
- [Disc heated by a localized source](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/disc_localized_heat_source/): Heat transfer · 2D. A thin steel disc held at 20 °C on its rim and heated by a 10 W Gaussian spot at its centre.
- [Effective thermal conductivity of a porous solid](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/porous_effective_conductivity_models/): Heat transfer · 3D. The effective conductivity of a ceramic with water-filled spherical pores is computed on 3D unit cells for four porosities and placed among the classical averaging models.
- [Floor slab and balcony thermal bridge (ISO 10211 case 3)](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/thermal_bridges_iso10211_cases/): Heat transfer · 3D. An external corner where the floor slab runs through the wall into a balcony: the 3D validation case of the building standard, between two rooms and outside air.
- [Free convection in a porous cavity](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/porous_cavity_free_convection/): Porous media flow · 2D. A square cavity filled with a fluid-saturated porous medium is heated on one side wall and cooled on the other, and the buoyant Darcy flow carries the heat across.
- [Free convection of air between two vertical plates](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/air_cavity_free_convection/): Free convection · 2D. Air in a 20 mm gap between a warm and a cool vertical plate starts to circulate and carries up to 2.2 times, at the strongest convection 4.5 times, the heat that conduction alone would.
- [Free-convection cooling of vertical circuit boards](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/vertical_circuit_boards_free_convection/): Free convection · 2D. Vertical circuit boards in a rack cooled without a fan: the chips heat their board and the air in the channel between two boards, the air rises and draws cool air in from below.
- [Freezing fronts in a soil column](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/soil_freezing_lunardini_1d/): Heat transfer with phase change · 1D. Trace the frozen and partially frozen zones as a −6 °C surface cools an initially warm soil column over three days.
- [Friction stir welding of an aluminium plate](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/friction_stir_welding_plate/): Heat transfer · 3D. The temperature field around the rotating tool travelling along the joint of an aluminium plate, seen from the tool.
- [HAMSTAD benchmark 2: moisture redistribution](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/hamstad_moisture_redistribution/): Moisture transport · 1D. A 200 mm hygroscopic wall in equilibrium with 95 % relative humidity dries towards 45 % and 65 % ambient air over 1000 hours.
- [Heat sink in a forced air flow](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/heat_sink_forced_air/): Conjugate heat transfer · 3D. An aluminium heat sink with three fins that cools a 1 W component in a small laminar air duct.
- [Heat transfer in a surface-mount package](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/surface_mount_package_heating/): Heat conduction · 3D. A voltage regulator heats a circuit board; one lead of a SOIC-16 package carries the heat through a copper strip to the silicon die, which dissipates 20 mW itself.
- [Heat transfer in laminar flow through a circular tube](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/laminar_tube_heat_transfer_graetz/): Forced convection · 3D. Oil flowing through a heated tube, where the Nusselt number falls along the thermal entry length to 3.66 for a fixed wall temperature and 4.36 for a fixed wall heat flux.
- [Heat transfer through a finned pipe](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/finned_pipe_heat_transfer/): Heat transfer · 3D. A copper pipe with thin disk fins and internal grooves, water inside and air outside, graded against the classical annular-fin efficiency.
- [Heating a spherical ore pellet](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/spherical_pellet_heating/): Heat transfer · 1D. Compare how quickly the centres of 2.5 mm and 5 mm magnetite pellets warm in a stream of hot gas.
- [Heating of buried power cables](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/buried_cables_heating/): Heat transfer · 2D. Three 132 kV cables buried side by side: how hot the conductors run, and how much they heat each other.
- [Homogenized thermal properties of a unidirectional fibre composite](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/fiber_composite_thermal_homogenization/): Heat transfer · 3D. The unit cell of a square array of glass fibres in epoxy gives the effective conductivity across and along the fibres, the effective density and the effective heat capacity of the composite.
- [Insulated shipping box with melting ice packs](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/isothermal_box_ice_packs/): Heat transfer · 3D. A foam shipping box with four eutectic ice plates on a hot summer day: how long the goods stay between 2 and 8 degC.
- [Laser beam absorbed in a silica glass rod](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/laser_absorption_silica_rod/): Heat transfer · 3D. A Gaussian laser beam travels along a fused-silica rod and is absorbed weakly; the glass heats up along the beam over ten seconds.
- [Laser heating of a rotating silicon wafer](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/laser_heating_rotating_wafer/): Heat transfer · 3D. A laser spot sweeps in and out over a silicon wafer turning on its stage and writes a hot spiral into it.
- [Laser heating of an absorbing slab (Beer-Lambert law)](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/beer_lambert_slab_heating/): Heat transfer · 3D. A Gaussian laser beam is absorbed gradually in a thin glass slab on a heat sink; the absorbed light heats the glass from inside.
- [Lid-driven flow in a cubic cavity](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/lid_driven_cube_3d/): Incompressible flow · 3D. The classic driven cavity as a real cube: how the end walls weaken the primary vortex at Re = 100 and 400.
- [Light bulb geometry](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/light_bulb_geometry/): CAD geometry · 3D. Glass envelope, filling gas, brass base and coiled filament of an incandescent lamp, built from revolved outlines and a wire swept along a helix.
- [Measuring thermal conductivity with a laser flash](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/flash_method_axisymmetric/): Transient heat conduction · 2D-axisymmetric. A 20 ms flash heats one face of a 12.7 mm disc. Measure the response on the other face and see how a cold sample holder changes the inferred conductivity.
- [Melting of a phase change material in a heated corner](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/pcm_corner_melting/): Heat transfer · 2D. A square block of solid paraffin is heated on two adjacent walls and melts from them, fastest at the corner.
- [Natural convection cooling of a vacuum flask](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/vacuum_flask_cooling/): Heat conduction · 2D-axisymmetric. How much heat a vacuum flask of hot coffee loses per hour, and through which parts: glass vessel, vacuum gap, steel shell, shoulder ring and stopper.
- [Newton cooling of a thermal mass](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/lumped_convective_cooling/): Heat transfer · 0D. A single thermal mass cooling by convection; the decay is graded against Newton's law of cooling.
- [Out-of-plane heat transfer in a thin plate](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/thin_plate_fin_cooling/): Heat transfer · 3D. An aluminium plate 100 times thinner than it is long, held hot at one edge and cooled by a liquid on both large faces.
- [Periodic surface temperature wave](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/periodic_surface_temperature_wave/): Heat transfer · 3D. A daily temperature cycle penetrating the ground, graded against the damped thermal wave.
- [Plate with convection (NAFEMS T4)](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/nafems_t4_plate_convection/): Heat conduction · 2D. The NAFEMS T4 benchmark: a plate held at 100 °C along its base and cooled by convection on two sides.
- [Rayleigh-Bénard convection: onset of the rolls](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/rayleigh_benard_convection_onset/): Free convection · 2D. A fluid layer heated from below stays at rest until the Rayleigh number passes 1707.8; then two counter-rotating convection rolls carry the heat.
- [Rod with a radiating end (NAFEMS T2)](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/rod_radiation_nafems_t2/): Heat conduction · 1D. The NAFEMS T2 benchmark: a rod held at 1000 K at one end that radiates to 300 K surroundings at the other.
- [Semi-infinite solid with a surface temperature step](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/semi_infinite_step_erfc/): Heat transfer · 3D. A long bar whose surface temperature jumps at t=0; the penetrating profile is graded against the error-function solution.
- [Temperature field in a cooling flange](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/cooling_flange_temperature/): Heat transfer · 3D. A fused-silica flange with three cooling fins: hot process fluid inside, air cooling outside that depends on the angle around the pipe.
- [Thermal bridge: composite wall (ISO 10211 case 2)](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/thermal_bridge_composite_iso10211/): Building physics · 2D. Test reference case 2 of EN ISO 10211: an aluminium profile and a wooden batten bridging the insulation of a wall.
- [Thermal bridge: square column (ISO 10211 case 1)](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/thermal_bridge_square_column_iso10211/): Building physics · 2D. Test reference case 1 of EN ISO 10211: half of a square column with one warm and three cold faces.
- [Thermal contact between an electronic package and a finned heat sink](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/package_heat_sink_thermal_contact/): Heat transfer · 3D. A cylindrical silicon package dissipating 5 W sits in the bore of an aluminium heat sink with eight fins cooled by an air stream; the rough interface conducts through solid spots and the gas in the gap.
- [Thermal model of a silicon microchannel heat sink](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/microchannel_heat_sink/): Conjugate heat transfer · 3D. A silicon heat sink with 50 µm water microchannels that carries 100 W/cm² away from a chip.
- [Transient conduction in a wall and a lumped thermal network](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/wall_transient_vs_lumped/): Heat transfer · 1D. A concrete house wall with inside insulation and plaster cools after a drop of the outdoor temperature, with convection and radiation on both faces.
- [Turbulent heat transfer from a heated flat plate](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/turbulent_flat_plate_heat_transfer/): Turbulent heat transfer · 2D. Air at 75 m/s flows along a 2 m flat plate held 40 K above the stream: the turbulent boundary layer carries the heat away, and the local Nusselt number grows with the 0.8th power of the Reynolds number.

### Fluids

- [Boundary-layer meshing](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/boundary_layer_meshing/): Meshing · 3D. The fluid around a cylinder in a duct, meshed with layers of flat cells on the cylinder and the duct walls.
- [Controlled diffusion separator](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/controlled_diffusion_separator/): Microfluidics · 3D. An H-shaped microchannel separator at its published operating point: the outlet concentrations for three molecule sizes.
- [Creating a fluid domain inside a solid structure](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/fluid_domain_inside_solid/): CAD geometry · 3D. The water inside a manifold block with a through bore and a branch, extracted as a solid of its own with walls and three closed openings.
- [Dam break on a column](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/dam_break_column_shallow_water/): Free-surface flow · 2D. A water column released behind a gate floods a tank and hits a square pillar: the 2D shallow-water wave, its reflections and the force on the pillar.
- [Droplet ejection from an inkjet nozzle](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/inkjet_nozzle_droplet_ejection/): Two-phase flow · 2D-axisymmetric. A piezo pulse pushes ink through a 20 µm-radius orifice and then draws the ink back. Follow the breakup of the jet and the shape of the ejected drop.
- [Flow past a cylinder (DFG benchmark 2D-1)](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/flow_past_cylinder_dfg_benchmark/): Incompressible flow · 2D. The classical channel flow past a circular cylinder at Re = 20: pressure drop across the cylinder and recirculation length against the international benchmark.
- [Gravity-driven film flow in a channel with side walls](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/film_flow_side_walls_3d/): Incompressible flow · 3D. A viscous liquid film running down an inclined open channel: how the side walls slow it down, from narrow slots to wide films.
- [Helical static mixer: mixing element by element](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/helical_static_mixer_elements/): Mixing · 3D. Six alternating helical blades in a pipe mix two liquids in creeping flow, followed element by element at two Péclet numbers.
- [Homogenized permeability of a sphere packing](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/periodic_sphere_array_permeability/): Porous media · 3D. Porosity and Darcy permeability of a simple cubic packing of spheres, homogenized from the 3D creeping flow through one periodic unit cell.
- [Lamella micromixer with hydrodynamic focusing](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/lamella_mixer_focusing/): Microfluidics · 3D. Two liquids enter a microchannel as 2, 4 or 8 alternating lamellae, are squeezed four times thinner in a contraction and mix by diffusion.
- [Laminar boundary layer on a flat plate](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/blasius_flat_plate/): Incompressible flow · 2D. The two-dimensional laminar boundary layer growing along a flat plate, graded against the Blasius similarity solution.
- [Laminar flow over a backward-facing step](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/backward_facing_step_flow/): Fluid flow · 2D. The channel behind a step of half the channel height, from Re = 100 to Re = 800, with the recirculation zones on both walls.
- [Laminar static mixer with twisted blades](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/kenics_static_mixer/): Mixing · 3D. Two twisted blades of the Kenics type in a pipe mix two liquids in creeping flow, compared with the same pipe without blades.
- [Lid-driven cavity at Re = 100](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/lid_driven_cavity/): Fluid flow · 2D. The classic driven-cavity flow at Re = 100: a moving lid drives a primary vortex in a square cavity.
- [Microchannel H-cell: separation by diffusion](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/microchannel_h_cell_diffusion/): Laminar flow and transport · 3D. Two water streams flow side by side through the 100 µm contact zone of an H-shaped microchannel; small molecules diffuse across, large ones stay in their stream.
- [Normal shock and the Rankine-Hugoniot relations](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/normal_shock_relations/): Compressible flow · 1D. A normal shock in a compressible gas, graded against the Rankine-Hugoniot relations.
- [Permeability of a hexagonal array of fibres](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/permeability_hexagonal_fibre_array/): Porous media · 3D. Porosity, tortuosity and permeability across a hexagonal array of fibres from the 3D creeping flow through one periodic unit cell, for seven solid fractions.
- [Permeability of a square array of fibres](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/permeability_square_fibre_array/): Porous media · 3D. The Darcy permeability across a square array of fibres from the 3D creeping flow through one periodic unit cell, for seven solid fractions.
- [Poiseuille channel flow](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/poiseuille_channel_flow/): Fluid flow · 3D. Pressure-driven laminar flow between two plates; the parabolic velocity profile is graded against theory.
- [Pore-scale flow through a micromodel](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/pore_scale_flow_micromodel/): Porous media · 2D. Water pushed through a micromodel packed with 32 irregularly placed grains, from creeping flow to pore Reynolds numbers of about 80.
- [Porous structure on the microscopic scale: a sintered grain packing](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/porous_microstructure_hexagonal_array/): Porous media · 3D. Porosity, specific surface, tortuosity and permeability of a body-centred grain packing, with separate and with sintered grains, from the resolved 3D pore flow in one periodic cell.
- [Rising bubble benchmark](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/rising_bubble_benchmark/): Two-phase flow · 2D. A gas bubble rises through a liquid ten times as dense, flattens and develops a dimpled rear: the quantitative two-phase benchmark of Hysing et al. on three meshes.
- [Rotating helix geometry](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/rotating_helix_geometry/): CAD geometry · 3D. A wire coil swept along a helix of three turns and turned in steps inside a vessel, with the fluid space meshed at every position.
- [Shallow-water equations: dam breaks and a lake at rest](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/shallow_water_dam_break_stoker/): Free-surface flow · 1D. Two dam breaks, onto a wet and onto a dry bed, and still water around an island, computed with the one-dimensional shallow-water equations.
- [Shallow-water wave speed](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/shallow_water_wave_speed/): Shallow water · 2D. A small surface perturbation on a still lake; the wave speed is graded against the square root of g h.
- [Ship hull geometry lofted through its stations](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/ship_hull_geometry/): CAD geometry · 3D. The Wigley hull of ship hydrodynamics, lofted through eleven stations with exact parabolic sides and cut at the waterline.
- [Sod shock tube with smoothed-particle hydrodynamics](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/sph_shock_tube/): Compressible flow · 1D. The Sod shock tube solved with Lagrangian particles, graded against the exact Riemann solution.
- [Split-and-recombine micromixer](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/split_recombine_micromixer/): Microfluidics · 3D. Two liquids pass two split-and-recombine elements in a square microchannel, which cut, reshape and restack the stream so that the layers double in each element.
- [Split-and-recombine micromixer at five flow rates](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/split_recombine_micromixer_flow_rates/): Microfluidics · 3D. The same split-and-recombine micromixer run as a batch of five flow rates, from Re = 0.15 to 2 and Péclet numbers 15 to 200.
- [Split-and-recombine mixer benchmark: layers, numerical and physical mixing](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/split_recombine_mixer_benchmark/): Microfluidics · 3D. A tracer passes three split-and-recombine elements that double its layers, computed on two meshes to separate the mixing by the scheme from the mixing by diffusion.
- [Star-shaped microchannel driven by five pulsating inlets](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/star_microchannel_superposition/): Microfluidics · 3D. A flat chamber fed by five inlet channels with sinusoidal pressures of five different frequencies, drained by one outlet tube.
- [Supersonic expansion fan at a convex corner](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/prandtl_meyer_expansion_fan/): Compressible flow · 2D. A Mach 2 stream turns round a wall that falls away by 10 degrees through a centred expansion fan.
- [Supersonic flow over a bump in a channel](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/supersonic_bump_channel_3d/): Compressible flow · 3D. Air at Mach 2 flows through a channel with a bump that covers half of its width; shocks and expansions from the bump fill the channel with a 3D wave pattern.
- [Tesla valve: diodicity over the Reynolds number and the loop length](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/tesla_valve_diodicity/): Microfluidics · 2D. A four-stage valve of the Tesla family without moving parts, flown through in both directions from creeping flow to Re = 300, for three loop lengths.
- [Turbulent boundary layer on a flat plate](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/turbulent_flat_plate_zero_pressure_gradient/): Turbulent flow · 2D. The turbulent boundary layer on a 2 m flat plate without pressure gradient at a Reynolds number of five million per metre, the standard verification case for turbulence models.
- [Turbulent flow over a backward-facing step](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/turbulent_backward_facing_step/): Turbulent flow · 2D. Air at 44 m/s flows over a 12.7 mm step in the wind-tunnel channel of Driver and Seegmiller (step Reynolds number 36 000): the classical test of how turbulence models handle separation, a free shear layer and reattachment.
- [Water hammer after a fast valve closure](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/water_hammer_valve_closure/): Pipe transients · 1D. A valve at the end of a reservoir-fed pipe closes in 0.2 s and sends a pressure wave up and down the pipe.
- [Womersley pulsatile flow](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/womersley_pulsatile_flow/): Fluid flow · 3D. Oscillatory pressure-driven flow between plates at Womersley number 3, graded against the analytic Womersley profile.

### Geotechnics

- [Aquifer compaction over a bedrock step](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/terzaghi_aquifer_compaction/): Poroelasticity · 2D. Ten years of groundwater withdrawal from a layered aquifer system over a buried bedrock step: head decline, land subsidence and the tension that opens fissures.
- [Bearing capacity of a strip footing](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/strip_footing_bearing_capacity/): Soil and rock plasticity · 2D. A smooth strip footing is pressed into a stratum of undrained clay until the soil under it fails.
- [Buckley-Leverett waterflood](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/buckley_leverett_waterflood/): Porous media flow · 1D. Water injected at one end of an oil-filled porous column pushes the oil out with a sharp saturation front.
- [Drained triaxial test](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/triaxial_test_mohr_coulomb/): Soil and rock plasticity · 2D-axisymmetric. A cylindrical soil sample is compressed under three cell pressures until it fails, as in the laboratory triaxial test.
- [Flow through a rough rock fracture](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/rock_fracture_reynolds_flow/): Fracture hydraulics · 2D. How strongly does the direction of a narrow gap control the water flow? A head difference of 20 mm drives three synthetic fracture maps.
- [Geoelectrical sounding over a layered earth](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/geoelectric_wenner_sounding/): Electric currents · 3D. A Wenner electrode array on a resistive top layer over a conductive basement, whose apparent resistivity over the electrode spacing reveals the layering.
- [Horizontal infiltration into unsaturated soil](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/richards_horizontal_infiltration/): Variably saturated flow · 1D. Water drawn into a dry loam column from a wetted end, graded against the exact Boltzmann similarity solution of the nonlinear Richards equation.
