- [Isotropic compression of clay with Modified Cam-Clay](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/isotropic_compression_cam_clay/): Soil plasticity · 2D-axisymmetric. A lightly overconsolidated clay sample is compressed isotropically, unloaded and reloaded, and its void ratio follows the normal compression and swelling lines.
- [Mandel-Cryer effect in a poroelastic sphere](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/mandel_cryer_consolidation/): Poroelasticity · 2D-axisymmetric. A water-saturated sphere suddenly loaded on its draining surface: the centre pore pressure first rises above its initial value before it decays.
- [Prestressed rock block in compression](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/prestressed_block_mohr_coulomb/): Soil and rock plasticity · 3D. A rock block under an isotropic initial stress is compressed vertically while its lateral stress is held, the standard verification of a 3D plasticity model.
- [Seawater intrusion in a coastal aquifer](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/seawater_intrusion_henry/): Porous media flow · 2D. Fresh groundwater flows to the sea through a confined aquifer while the denser seawater intrudes along its base as a salt wedge (Henry's problem).
- [Stresses around a multilateral well junction](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/multilateral_well_stability/): Rock mechanics · 3D. A vertical well with an inclined lateral leg is drilled into rock under anisotropic in-situ stresses and mud pressure; the stresses around the junction show where the wall may fail in shear.
- [Thermal breakthrough of a geothermal doublet](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/geothermal_doublet/): Porous media flow, heat transport · 3D. Cold water reinjected into a hot aquifer spreads towards the production well 600 m away and starts to cool it after fifteen to twenty years.
- [Triaxial and oedometer tests with Modified Cam-Clay](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/triaxial_oedometer_cam_clay/): Soil plasticity · 2D-axisymmetric. A normally consolidated and a heavily overconsolidated clay sample are sheared in drained triaxial compression, and a third sample is compressed and unloaded in an oedometer.
- [Waterflood with horizontal wells](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/horizontal_wells_waterflood/): Porous media flow · 3D. Water injected through a horizontal well near the base of an oil reservoir pushes the oil up to a horizontal producer under the cap rock.
- [Wicking in a paper strip](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/paper_strip_wicking/): Unsaturated porous flow · 2D. A dry strip of filter paper hanging with its lower edge in water draws the water up by capillary suction until gravity slows the rise.

### Mechanics

- [Adjusting the element size of an unstructured mesh](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/unstructured_mesh_element_size/): Meshing · 3D. A flanged boss with a bore and four bolt holes, meshed again and again to show what each size control of the tetrahedral mesher does.
- [Bending mode shapes of a cantilever](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/beam_mode_shapes/): Solid mechanics · 3D. The first two bending mode shapes of a clamped beam, graded against the Euler-Bernoulli eigenfunctions.
- [Bending of a clamped beam](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/cantilever_beam_bending/): Solid mechanics · 3D. A clamped beam under an end load: the 3D deflection is graded against Euler-Bernoulli beam theory.
- [Bending of a simply supported cross-ply laminate](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/composite_laminate_bending/): Composites · 3D. A thick square [0/90/0] composite laminate, simply supported on all edges, under a doubly sinusoidal pressure.
- [Brittle damage of a bar in tension](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/brittle_bar_phase_field/): Fracture mechanics · 2D. A concrete bar is stretched until it breaks, with the AT2 phase-field damage model in plane stress.
- [Brittle fracture of a holed plate](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/holed_plate_phase_field/): Fracture mechanics · 2D. A brittle plate with an edge notch and an off-centre hole is pulled apart; the crack starts at the notch, curves into the hole and breaks the ligament on the other side.
- [Chladni figures of a free square plate](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/chladni_plate_free_modes/): Structural dynamics · 3D. A thin square brass plate, free on all edges, vibrates in its natural modes; the nodal lines are the sand figures that Chladni made visible with a violin bow.
- [Combining CAD geometry with a triangle mesh](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/cad_and_mesh_combined/): CAD import · 3D. A knob that exists only as triangles from an STL file, given an exact CAD stem by a union and a bore by a difference, then meshed.
- [Cracking of a notched concrete beam](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/notched_beam_phase_field/): Fracture mechanics · 2D. A notched concrete beam is bent between two supports until a crack runs from the notch towards the load.
- [Creep relaxation in a hot thick-walled tube](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/hot_tube_creep_relaxation/): Creep · 2D-axisymmetric. A thick-walled pipe under internal pressure creeps at high temperature; the stresses relax from the elastic Lamé distribution to the stationary creep distribution.
- [Creep relaxation of thermal stresses in a turbine stator vane](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/turbine_stator_blade_creep/): Creep · 3D. A nickel-alloy stator vane, heated more at the leading edge than at the trailing edge and held by the shrouds, relaxes its thermal stresses by creep over 1000 hours.
- [Cross-section properties of standard steel beams](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/beam_section_properties/): Beam sections · 2D. Area, second moments, torsion constant, shear centre and warping constant of an IPE 200, a welded box and a lipless channel, and the normal stress of a combined load.
- [Curvature of a prestressed micromirror](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/prestressed_micromirror_curvature/): Thin-film stress · 3D. A polysilicon micromirror plated with a gold film whose residual tensile stress bends it into a shallow bowl.
- [Deformation of a feeder clamp](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/feeder_clamp_deformation/): Structural mechanics · 3D. An aluminium clamp holds a high-frequency feeder line: how far the feeder seat moves and tilts under the pull of the line, and where the clamp is most stressed.
- [Editing and repairing surface meshes](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/surface_mesh_editing_repair/): Surface meshes · 3D. A dense triangle skin of a ball with an open cap and a torn patch, repaired, thinned out, laid anew and filled with tetrahedra.
- [Elastic constants from a tensile test by maximum likelihood](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/tensile_test_parameter_estimation/): Parameter estimation · 3D. Young's modulus and Poisson's ratio of steel identified from the force and the contraction of a flat dog-bone specimen in a tensile test.
- [Elastic-plastic low-cycle fatigue of a shaft with a transverse hole](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/cylinder_hole_low_cycle_fatigue_swt/): Fatigue · 3D. A steel shaft with a transverse hole carries fully reversed, in-phase tension and torsion; the edge of the hole yields in every cycle and the life follows from the stabilized cycle.
- [Elastoplastic parameters from cyclic shear](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/elastoplastic_parameter_estimation/): Parameter estimation · 0D. Young's modulus, yield stress and the isotropic and kinematic hardening moduli of a steel are identified from a cyclic shear test.
- [Elastoplastic perforated plate in plane stress](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/holed_plate_elastoplastic_plane_stress/): Plasticity · 2D. An aluminium strip with a large central hole is pulled into the plastic range and released again, after the classical perforated-plate study of Zienkiewicz, Valliappan and King.
- [Elliptic membrane under outward pressure (NAFEMS LE1)](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/elliptic_membrane_le1/): Linear elasticity · 2D. The NAFEMS LE1 benchmark: a thin elliptic ring pulled outwards by a uniform pressure on its outer edge.
- [Fatigue life with rainflow cycle counting](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/fatigue_cycle_counting_component/): Fatigue · 2D. A notched specimen under a variable-amplitude load block: count the cycles, apply an S-N curve with mean-stress effect, and find where and when it fails.
- [Four-point bending test of a layered module](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/four_point_bending_layered_module/): Structural mechanics · 3D. A strip of a power-electronics module (copper baseplate, solder, alumina substrate, copper layer) in the four-point bending test: the stress in every layer between the rollers.
- [Free vibration modes of a turbocharger rotor](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/turbocharger_rotor_free_modes/): Structural dynamics · 3D. A simplified turbocharger rotor with turbine wheel, thrust collar and compressor wheel is analysed free-free, as on a soft suspension in a modal test.
- [Geometry clean-up of a wheel rim](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/wheel_rim_defeaturing/): CAD geometry · 3D. A cast wheel rim with five windows, lug holes, rounded window edges and a valve hole, cleaned of its small details before meshing.
- [Helical spring driven by a global displacement constraint](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/loaded_spring_global_constraint/): Structural mechanics · 3D. A helical spring is compressed by prescribing the mean axial displacement of its loaded wire end; the force follows from one extra global equation.
- [Hertz contact of a steel ball on a block](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/hertz_sphere_on_flat_3d/): Contact mechanics · 3D. A steel ball pressed onto a steel block: contact patch, pressure and the subsurface shear peak where rolling-contact fatigue starts.
- [Hertz line contact of a cylinder on an elastic block](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/hertz_line_contact/): Contact mechanics · 2D. A rigid cylinder pressed into an elastic block, graded against the Hertz pressure distribution for the transmitted force.
- [In-plane frame carrying a mass with rotary inertia](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/planar_frame_point_mass_modes/): Structural dynamics · 2D. An L-shaped steel frame, clamped at its base, carries a compact machine at the end of its arm, modelled as a point mass with a mass moment of inertia.
- [Koch snowflake built by recursion](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/koch_snowflake_recursion/): CAD geometry · 2D. The Koch snowflake from the triangle to level 5 with 3,072 sides, built as planar regions and meshed with triangles.
- [Ladder frame geometry and mid-surface](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/ladder_frame_geometry/): CAD geometry · 3D. A vehicle ladder frame of two channel rails and four cross members, built from plates and reduced to the mid-surface of its walls.
- [Menger sponge as a recursively defined CAD object](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/menger_sponge_recursive_geometry/): CAD geometry · 3D. The Menger sponge of levels 0 to 2, a cube with 30 square bars cut through it, built and meshed as one solid.
- [Meshing sequences and six meshers on one part](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/meshing_sequences_one_part/): Meshing · 3D. A connecting link with two eyes meshed by six meshers and by a four-step meshing sequence that rebuilds only what changes.
- [Mixed-mode angled crack](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/angled_crack_mixed_mode/): Fracture mechanics · 2D. A steel plate with an inclined central crack is pulled at its ends, and the opening and sliding stress intensity factors are computed for four crack angles.
- [Modifying an imported CAD part by deforming its mesh](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/deforming_imported_cad_part/): Mesh deformation · 3D. A clamp block read from a STEP file, made shorter and longer and given a crowned top by moving the nodes of one mesh instead of remodelling.
- [Moisture uptake and swelling stresses in a paperboard roll](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/paperboard_roll_moisture_swelling/): Hygroscopic swelling · 2D-axisymmetric. A wrapped paperboard roll stored at 50 % humidity takes up moisture from its ends at 80 %, and the board swells strongly through its thickness and little along the sheets.
- [Mooney-Rivlin fit to Treloar's rubber](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/mooney_rivlin_treloar_fit/): Hyperelasticity · 0D. The two-parameter Mooney-Rivlin model is fitted to Treloar's classical tests on natural rubber in uniaxial tension, equibiaxial tension and pure shear.
- [Moving wheel load on a simply supported deck](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/moving_load_bridge_deck/): Structural mechanics · 3D. A 100 kN wheel load crosses a simply supported concrete deck slab; its position is a function of time and the midspan deflection traces the influence line.
- [Multiaxial high-cycle fatigue of a cylindrical specimen](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/cylindrical_specimen_multiaxial_hcf/): Fatigue · 3D. A cylindrical steel specimen is loaded by alternating tension and torsion with a phase shift between the two, and three critical-plane fatigue parameters are evaluated at its surface.
- [Natural frequencies of a free thick cylinder (NAFEMS FV41)](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/free_cylinder_axisymmetric_modes/): Structural dynamics · 2D axisymmetric. The NAFEMS FV41 benchmark: the axisymmetric natural frequencies of an unsupported thick-walled steel tube.
- [Natural frequency of a cantilever](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/cantilever_natural_frequency/): Solid mechanics · 3D. The fundamental bending frequency of a clamped beam, graded against Euler-Bernoulli theory.
- [Natural frequency of a clamped-clamped beam](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/fixed_fixed_beam_frequency/): Solid mechanics · 3D. The fundamental frequency of a doubly clamped beam, graded against Euler-Bernoulli.
- [Non-proportional fatigue of a shaft shoulder](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/shaft_fillet_nonproportional_fatigue/): Fatigue · 3D. A stepped steel shaft carries a transverse force and a torque in five combinations, and the fatigue risk at the shoulder fillet is rated with three multiaxial criteria.
- [Notch approximation for the low-cycle fatigue of a shaft with a transverse hole](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/cylinder_hole_neuber_notch_fatigue/): Fatigue · 3D. A steel shaft with a transverse hole carries fully reversed tension and torsion; the yielding edge of the hole is estimated from a purely elastic analysis with the Neuber and Glinka notch rules.
- [Ogden parameters from Treloar's tests](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/ogden_treloar_parameter_estimation/): Hyperelasticity · 0D. The six parameters of the three-term Ogden model are estimated from Treloar's tests on natural rubber in uniaxial tension, equibiaxial tension and pure shear.
- [Phase-field fracture of a notched tension specimen](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/phase_field_fracture_sent/): Fracture · 2D. The single-edge-notched tension benchmark: a crack nucleates at the notch tip and runs straight across the plate, predicted without tracking the crack explicitly.
- [Plane and space truss](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/plane_and_space_truss/): Truss structures · 3D. A pin-jointed steel truss loaded at mid-span, solved first as a plane truss and then as a space truss with a triangular cross-section.
- [Plasticity and creep in a heated thick-walled cylinder](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/thick_cylinder_plasticity_creep/): Creep and plasticity · 3D. A thick-walled steel cylinder is heated from the inside until its wall yields, then pressurised and held for 2000 hours while it creeps.
- [Polynomial hyperelastic rubber](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/polynomial_hyperelastic_block/): Hyperelasticity · 3D. A rubber block is stretched in uniaxial tension, equibiaxial tension and pure shear with a hyperelastic material defined by its strain energy polynomial.
- [Pratt truss bridge](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/pratt_truss_bridge/): Truss and frame structures · 3D. A 24 m steel through-truss bridge with two Pratt trusses, floor beams and lateral bracing under deck and traffic load at the panel points.
- [Pressure vessel with hemispherical heads](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/pressure_vessel_hemispherical_heads/): Linear elasticity · 3D. A closed steel vessel under internal pressure: membrane stresses far from the welds and the bending stresses that appear where the cylinder meets the hemispherical head.
- [Primary and secondary creep in a hot thick-walled tube](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/combined_primary_secondary_creep/): Creep · 2D-axisymmetric. A hot pressurised pipe creeps with a primary Norton-Bailey stage on top of its secondary Norton creep; both laws act together at every point of the wall.
- [Primary creep under a changing load](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/primary_creep_nonconstant_load/): Creep · 3D. A block of a high-temperature alloy creeps for 50 hours under tension; then a transverse compression is added and the two classical hardening rules of primary creep part ways.
- [Random geometry of spherical inclusions](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/random_inclusions_geometry/): CAD geometry · 3D. Forty-nine spheres of random size and position in a cube, placed with a minimum gap and meshed together with the matrix.
- [Removing details in model geometries](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/removing_small_details/): CAD geometry · 3D. A machined block with a half-millimetre strip, a groove, a small hole and two edge rounds, cleaned up before meshing.
- [Scordelis-Lo roof](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/scordelis_lo_roof_shell/): Shells · 3D. The Scordelis-Lo roof: a thin cylindrical shell on two end diaphragms that sags under its own weight.
- [Singular stress at a re-entrant corner](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/reentrant_corner_singular_stress/): Linear elasticity · 2D. An L-shaped plate whose sharp inner corner carries a stress that is infinite in theory, compared with the same plate with a 2 mm fillet.
- [Static stress in a sheet-metal bracket](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/bracket_static_stress/): Linear elasticity · 3D. A bolted U-bracket carrying a pin load through two lugs: stresses in the arms, around the loaded holes and at the supports.
- [Stiffness of a mast diagonal with welded end plates](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/mast_diagonal_mounting_stiffness/): Linear elasticity · 3D. A tubular lattice-mast diagonal with gusset plates welded into slotted tube ends and bolted, pulled along its axis.
- [STL import and facet repair](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/stl_import_facet_repair/): CAD import · 3D. A damaged STL file of a pillow block, a third of its triangles facing inwards and six missing, turned into a closed body and an exact CAD solid.
- [Stress around a small hole in a large plate (Kirsch)](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/kirsch_plate_hole_stress/): Linear elasticity · 2D. A large steel plate with a small circular hole pulled in one direction, the classic Kirsch problem of stress concentration.
- [Stress concentration at a superelliptic hole](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/superellipse_hole_stress_concentration/): Linear elasticity · 2D. Plates with holes between a circle and a rounded square, the superellipse |x/a|^n + |y/a|^n = 1, pulled in one direction.
- [Stress intensity factor of an edge crack](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/edge_crack_stress_intensity/): Fracture mechanics · 2D. A steel plate with an edge crack is pulled at its ends, for four crack lengths, and the stress intensity factor at the crack tip is computed.
- [Stress relaxation of a viscoelastic tube heated through its wall](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/viscoelastic_tube_thermal_relaxation/): Viscoelasticity · 2D-axisymmetric. A thick-walled polymer tube, held expanded on a core, is heated from the bore; heat flows through the wall and the clamping stress relaxes fastest where the material is warm.
- [Stresses in a combination wrench](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/wrench_stress_analysis/): Linear elasticity · 3D. A 13 mm wrench turning a bolt: bending in the handle and the stress concentration in the rounded throat of the jaws.
- [Stresses in a gantry crane with internal hinges](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/portal_crane_frame_stress/): Beams and frames · 3D. A whole 15-tonne gantry crane, with clamped fixed legs and hinged pendulum legs, is computed as a 3D frame for self-weight, payload and a hot summer day.
- [Stresses in a rotating pulley](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/rotating_pulley_stresses/): Linear elasticity · 2D. A spoked belt pulley at constant power: how belt pull and centrifugal load trade off between low and high speed.
- [Submodel of a stepped shaft](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/shaft_fillet_submodel/): Linear elasticity · 3D. A stepped steel shaft in bending whose shoulder fillet is resolved by a finely meshed submodel driven by a coarse model of the whole shaft.
- [Submodel of a vent hole in a steel wheel](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/wheel_rim_submodel/): Linear elasticity · 3D. A pressed steel wheel bolted to the hub and loaded at the tyre contact patch, whose most loaded vent hole is resolved by a finely meshed submodel.
- [Submodel with plasticity at a hole](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/plate_hole_plastic_submodel/): Plasticity · 3D. A steel plate with a hole is computed elastically as a whole, and the region around the hole, where the stress exceeds the yield limit, is recomputed as an elastoplastic submodel.
- [Swept hexahedral mesh of a bracket](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/bracket_swept_hexahedral_mesh/): Meshing · 3D. A gusset bracket with three holes and a bent strap, filled with hexahedra swept straight through the plate and piece by piece round the bend.
- [Tapered cantilever with two load cases](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/tapered_cantilever_load_cases/): Linear elasticity · 2D. A thin steel cantilever whose depth halves from root to tip, loaded once by a tip force and once by a distributed load on its upper edge.
- [Thermal stress in a cooled turbine stator blade](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/turbine_stator_blade_thermal_stress/): Thermal stress · 3D. A nickel-alloy stator vane in the hot gas, cooled from inside through three radial channels, with the thermal stress its temperature field causes.
- [Thermal stresses in a coated plate](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/layered_plate_thermal_stress/): Thermoelasticity · 2D. A ceramic-coated substrate cooled from its stress-free temperature: bending, interface stresses and the peel stress concentration at the free edge.
- [Thermally loaded beam with 3D beam elements](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/thermally_loaded_beam_frame/): Beams and frames · 3D. A simply supported steel beam bent about both axes by temperature differences across its height and its width.
- [Thick elliptic plate under pressure (NAFEMS LE10)](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/thick_plate_pressure_le10/): Linear elasticity · 3D. The NAFEMS LE10 benchmark: a thick elliptic ring plate under uniform pressure, graded against the published stress at point D.
- [Tuning a fork to concert A](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/tuning_fork_prong_length_optimization/): Structural mechanics · 3D. Change the length of two round steel prongs until their opening mode reaches concert pitch. Each trial updates the CAD model and solves the elastic eigenproblem.
- [Tuning fork: the 440 Hz prong mode](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/tuning_fork_440_hz/): Structural dynamics · 3D. A steel tuning fork whose prongs were sized with beam theory for concert pitch A, held at its stem.
- [Viscoelastic structural damper](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/viscoelastic_damper_response/): Viscoelasticity · 3D. A building damper of steel plates bonded by two viscoelastic layers under harmonic wind or seismic load: stiffness, loss factor and the energy dissipated per cycle.
- [Wrapping flat profiles onto curved faces](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/wrapping_profile_on_curved_faces/): CAD geometry · 3D. A label strip and lettering wrapped around a shaft without stretching, a patch sunk into a cone and a disc raised on a sphere.

### Multiphysics

- [Inductive heating of a copper cylinder](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/inductive_heating_copper_cylinder/): Eddy currents and heat transfer · 2D-axisymmetric. A coil at 2 kHz heats a copper cylinder by eddy currents; the falling conductivity of the warming copper raises the induced power.
- [Thermal expansion in a MEMS device](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/mems_thermal_actuator_expansion/): Thermal stress · 3D. A copper-beryllium meander of four hairpins, 10 µm thick, heated by its drive current and expanding on the board it is bonded to.
- [Thermal stress in a fuel-cell bipolar plate](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/fuel_cell_bipolar_plate_thermal_stress/): Thermoelasticity · 3D. A titanium bipolar plate warmed by its start-up heater: how high the thermal stress climbs, where it peaks and how far the plate bulges against the membrane seal.
- [Thermal warpage of a printed circuit board](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/pcb_thermal_warpage/): Thermomechanics · 3D. A circuit board with a full copper layer on one side only, heated from room temperature to the 260 °C reflow peak, bows into a dish.

### Plasma & MHD

- [Capacitively coupled helium discharge: PIC benchmark case 1](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/capacitive_helium_discharge_pic/): Particle-in-cell · 1D. A 13.56 MHz helium discharge between two parallel electrodes, simulated with electron and ion macro-particles until it reaches its periodic steady state.
- [Circularly polarized waves in a magnetized plasma layer](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/magnetized_plasma_slab_waves/): Electromagnetic waves · 3D. A circularly polarized GHz wave falls on a lossy plasma layer magnetized along its normal; the right-hand wave is absorbed at the electron cyclotron resonance, the left-hand wave passes.
- [Electron plasma oscillations with particle-in-cell](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/plasma_oscillation_pic/): Kinetic plasma · 1D. Cold and warm electron plasma waves in a periodic box, graded against the plasma frequency and the Bohm-Gross dispersion relation.
- [Hartmann layers in a liquid-metal duct](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/hartmann_layer_duct_section/): Magnetohydrodynamics · 2D. Fully developed flow of a liquid metal through an insulating rectangular duct across a magnetic field, with the thin Hartmann layers on the walls normal to the field.
- [Ion cyclotron motion and E x B drift](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/ion_cyclotron_motion/): Charged particles · 0D. A proton gyrating on a helix in a uniform 0.1 T field and drifting sideways when a crossed electric field is added.
- [Oblique whistler and ion-cyclotron waves in Hall MHD](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/oblique_whistler_waves_3d/): Hall magnetohydrodynamics · 3D. Measure the frequency of one oblique whistler wave, then benchmark fourteen modes in a three-dimensional periodic plasma.

### Systems

- [Battery overdischarge protection with shunt resistors](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/battery_shunt_overdischarge/): Batteries · 0D. Two lithium cells in series, one with an internal short: how switched shunt resistors stop the weak cell from being driven into reversal.
- [Black-Scholes European call](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/black_scholes_european_call/): Quantitative finance · 1D. An at-the-money one-year European call option priced by solving the Black-Scholes equation in the log share price.
- [Dzhanibekov effect: the flipping T-handle](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/dzhanibekov_t_handle/): Rigid-body dynamics · 3D. A T-handle spinning in weightlessness turns over again and again when it spins about its intermediate principal axis.
- [Golf ball trajectory with drag and Magnus lift](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/golf_ball_trajectory/): Ballistics · 0D. A 7-iron shot with backspin: why dimples make the ball fly further than a smooth one, and how three time integrators compare.
- [Heat exchange between two thermal masses](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/two_mass_thermal_exchange/): Thermal networks · 0D. Two insulated thermal masses exchanging heat, graded against the exponential equalisation.
- [Lorenz attractor and chaos](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/lorenz_attractor_chaos/): Nonlinear dynamics · 0D. The three Lorenz equations, from a stable focus at rho = 15 to the butterfly-shaped strange attractor at rho = 28.
- [Lumped model of a vehicle suspension with occupants](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/vehicle_suspension_lumped_model/): Vehicle dynamics · 0D. A car body with heave, pitch and roll, four wheels and two seats with occupants form an 11-degree-of-freedom network of masses, springs and dampers.
- [Proportional control of a first-order plant](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/first_order_plant_p_control/): Control · 0D. A first-order plant under proportional feedback, graded against the closed-loop first-order response.
- [Series RLC circuit](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/series_rlc_circuit/): Circuits · 0D. The damped oscillation of a series RLC circuit, graded against the closed-form solution.
- [Spacecraft on a transfer orbit](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/spacecraft_kepler_orbit/): Orbital mechanics · 0D. A spacecraft on a geostationary transfer orbit, from 250 km perigee to 42 164 km apogee, followed for three revolutions.
- [Tank draining through an orifice](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/tank_draining_torricelli/): Hydraulics · 0D. A tank emptying through an orifice, graded against Torricelli's law.
- [Tank reactors in series with feedback control](https://onesimulation.onrender.com/blog/tank_series_feedback_control/): Control · 0D. Three stirred tank reactors in series whose inlet concentration a controller adjusts so that the outlet of the last tank follows a set point.
